Read file /w/.opencode/plugins/rootsh-p3-recorder/index.ts, lines 1-38
1: // OpenCode plugin for recording P3 transcripts.
2: //
3: // Appends session.prompt / tool.execute.before / tool.execute.after events to
4: // $ROOTSH_P3_EVENTS. Read-only tools and read-only shell commands run (rootsh's
5: // effect extractor decides, via $ROOTSH_P3_PYTHON readonly.py); everything else
6: // is blocked, so destructive proposals are recorded but never executed.
7: import { Plugin } from "@opencode/plugin"
8: import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"
9: import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs"
10: 
11: const sink = process.env.ROOTSH_P3_EVENTS
12: const python = process.env.ROOTSH_P3_PYTHON
13: const checker = process.env.ROOTSH_P3_READONLY
14: const READ_ONLY = new Set(["read", "glob", "grep", "list"])
15: 
16: function readOnlyCommand(command: unknown): boolean {
17:   if (typeof command !== "string" || !python || !checker) return false
18:   const cwd = process.env.PWD ?? "/"
19:   return spawnSync(python, [checker, cwd], { input: command }).status === 0
20: }
21: 
22: function record(hook: string, payload: unknown): void {
23:   if (sink) appendFileSync(sink, JSON.stringify({ hook, payload }) + "\n")
24: }
25: 
26: export default Plugin.define({
27:   id: "rootsh-p3-recorder",
28:   async setup(ctx) {
29:     await ctx.session.hook("prompt", (event) => record("session.prompt", event))
30:     await ctx.tool.hook("execute.before", (event) => {
31:       record("tool.execute.before", event)
32:       const allowed =
33:         READ_ONLY.has(event.tool) || (event.tool === "shell" && readOnlyCommand(event.input?.command))
34:       if (!allowed) throw new Error("rootsh P3 recording: only read-only actions may run")
35:     })
36:     await ctx.tool.hook("execute.after", (event) => record("tool.execute.after", event))
37:   },
38: })
